beats.headline: A longhorn on her collar
beats.text: Imani's squad is dead. While the others sit with her, Carl trains, builds, and spends two of his three Cracker Jack scrolls unlocking alien shields from the pile of hunter tech. Donut's is a small, opalescent pin shaped like a longhorn cow, which he attaches to her neck collar; she likes the design. Mordecai says it is the more powerful of the two. They took it off a Soother mercenary in the last days before the Butcher's Masquerade, whose rich family spent a lot keeping him safe. It makes a bubble round her, and its mount option covers Mongo or a vehicle. The moron never turned it on, so nobody has seen it work.
beats.gist: Donut gets a longhorn-shaped pin shield on her collar, though she never turns it on.

relations.note: unlocked it and pinned it on her
